text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I learned from the official website that 
there would be an event for a recently 
released B-movie. The event itself was 
small—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently they're going to play 'Red 
Light, Green Light with Tag,' a game 
featured in the movie. The participation 
prize is a movie badge."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On their official social media, the staff 
had posted things like, 'We hope this 
brings a bit of excitement,' but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, isn't that a bit too plain? Like, it 
kinda lacks hype for my big appearance.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well sure, the movie itself is pretty 
niche—more like a cult B-movie only 
diehards know about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's Transcend and Tokai Teio. 
...Apparently, they share the same goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was Transcend who originally 
recommended this movie to me. She called 
it a masterpiece where the director's 
niche, uncompromised tastes were on full 
display, completely disregarding general 
audiences.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking about the hype means, most likely, 
Transcend saw the official post too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There probably won't be that many 
participants either, so compared to the 
kinds of events Teio-chan usually takes 
part in...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right? In that case, I think it'd be way 
more fun to go all out and bust some moves 
at the arcade!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, I see. True, true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend nods in agreement with Tokai 
Teio. I wonder why... She's supposed to 
want to hype up this event too, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's too bad, but I guess it can't be 
helped. It's not like an Umamusume race or 
concert, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If this had been a place with Umamusume 
fans to begin with, the whole venue 
would've exploded the moment Teio-chan 
walked out~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's only B-movie fans, after all. The 
game's pretty low-key too, so joining in 
probably wouldn't get much hype~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's ears twitched at those words.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But, there might be race fans among 
them, right? I have tons of fans 
everywhere, after all!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, but like I said before, there aren't 
many people, so there's only so hyped you 
can get, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmh, grr... That's, that's just...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You'll never know unless you go and see 
for yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, well then, shall we check it out for 
now~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, our roles had 
reversed. I called out to the two of them, 
who seemed to be heading to the event, and 
we walked to the venue together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A modest event renting a corner of the 
park. As expected, there were few 
participants, and passersby walked past 
with indifferent looks.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
More people are just walking on by than 
actually taking part. I really don't think 
we can get things hyped up like this~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mgggh...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Unless you have some extraordinary charm 
that draws people in, that is. ...Right, 
Trai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, understanding Transcend's 
intention—"
choice_data_list: Maybe Teio could pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you totally get it! That is 
exaaaactly right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about races or concerts! 
Wherever I am, that place becomes a grand 
stage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whenever Lady Teio shines, there's no way 
the crowd won't go wild!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh~. Could this possibly be, what I 
think it is~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! How d'ya like that! That's the 
true power of the great Tokai Teio~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she proudly and passionately 
declared, Tokai Teio captivated the 
passersby with her brilliant movements. 
The event turned out to be an astounding 
success.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Count me in, count me in~ As expected of 
Teio-chan. You're just overflowing with 
magnetic charm~."
choice_data_list: ...You're really good at hyping people up.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You're really the one to talk, Trai-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wearing a mischievous grin, Transcend 
watched over the buzzing venue.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hooold on a second--!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can't just let that slide! Sure, the 
President is cool and the absolute best, 
but I'm not gonna lose to her!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Got it? Just watch! Movie buffs, casual 
passersby— I'll turn every single one of 
them into my fans!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, staff! Isn't the event starting 
yet? I'll even help out, so let's get 
things moving already!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, we're setting this up? Leave it to me! 
I can easily lift something like this all 
by myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio effortlessly lifted a piece of 
equipment larger than herself. The 
onlookers were transfixed, and cheers 
erupted around her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on everyone, don't just watch! Let's 
liven up this event together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Tokai Teio's cheerfulness and power 
captivated many. What had been a quiet 
event burst into bustling life as if by 
magic.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. The staff, the customers... Everyone 
has such wonderful smiles on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the official account 
happily posted on social media: "The 
greatest and strongest Umamusume has 
joined us!"
